description: Soul Family brings officially licensed spiritual teachings and guided meditations to ChatGPT. Explore Kryon, channeled by Lee Carroll, and The Stargate Experience, with new meditations and teachings published regularly. The app is designed to welcome additional participating teachers over time. Users can search by topic, listen in the widget, browse recent uploads and free events, and request free personalized meditation paths through an in-widget email form. Content focuses on spiritual evolution, wellness and balance, life purpose and soul mission, consciousness expansion, and deeper self-awareness. All content is officially licensed from the original teachers, supporting their continued work.
